sourceText.he: גְּמָ׳ מַאן תַּנָּא דְּעִיקַּר אִילָן אַרְעָא הִיא?! אָמַר רַב נַחְמָן בַּר יִצְחָק: רַבִּי יְהוּדָה הִיא, דִּתְנַן: יָבֵשׁ הַמַּעְיָן וְנִקְצַץ הָאִילָן — מֵבִיא וְאֵינוֹ קוֹרֵא. רַבִּי יְהוּדָה אוֹמֵר: מֵבִיא וְקוֹרֵא.

positions.basis: the Bikkurim mishna, where R' Yehuda rules that one brings and reads even after the tree was felled

positions.claim: One whose tree was felled or spring dried brings first fruits and reads the declaration
positions.basis: the ground is the primary factor; the tree is an extension of it

positions.claim: One whose tree was felled or spring dried brings first fruits but does not read
